item.title: Drain cover makes loud noise every time a vehicle goes over it., 3rd July
item.description:
The problem is on the mini roundabout between Moorend Road, Moorend Park Road and Moorend Grove. The manhole is usally crossed by cars heading down Moorend Road and going straight towards Moorend Park Road. The issue has been going on for about 6 weeks now, but I can hear it in almost every room in my house - other nearby neighbours on the road, will feel the same.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Moorend Grove, Warden Hill, Cheltenham
